equipment_type: Thermostat (rooftop, heat pump and fan coil)
applies_to: Honeywell TC500A commercial touchscreen thermostat for conventional rooftop units, heat pumps and fan coils, with economizer, DCV and Sylk bus sensors.
summary: The TC500A is a commercial touchscreen thermostat that talks BACnet MS/TP on its RS-485 terminals or BACnet IP over Wi-Fi (one at a time). The guide lists objects for terminal I/O, application configuration (conventional, heat pump, fan coil, economizer), setpoints, network inputs, network outputs, alarms, display points and schedules. Network inputs let a BMS share outdoor air, space values, occupancy and emergency overrides.
notes: Access comes from the Access column or the table notes ("All points are writable" / "read-only").

The guide gives the same type and instance to two different objects in 28 places (for example MV 20 is both Cfg_Heat_HeatType and no_EffOccState, MV 8 both Cfg_Thermostat_SysSwitch and no_ApplicationCommandMode). Both objects of each clashing pair are left out until a device confirms which is right.
The short 'basic setup' table at the front of the guide has its type and instance columns shifted against the names; the detailed chapter tables are used instead.
Cfg_Econ_MinDamperPos (AV 320) and the Low/Med variants (AV 321/322) are described per fan-speed count in the guide; each is listed once.
'Boolean Value' in the guide is listed as BV. Objects shown on several pages are listed once.

integration.summary: Drive mode with MV 3 ni_ApplicationMode and occupancy with BV 158 ni_OccupancySensor, and write the occupied setpoints AV 7 / AV 4. Read effective setpoints AO 3 / AO 4, space temperature AO 18 and fan status BO 19. Outdoor and space values can be shared in through the ni_ inputs.

minimum_points.why: Fan coil fan speed: auto, low, medium, high, off
minimum_points.name: Cfg_FanCoilManualSpeedSel

integration.enable: The BMS steers the thermostat through ni_ network inputs: application mode (MV 3, not kept over a power cycle), occupancy (BV 158), bypass (BV 1), shutdown (BV 4) and smoke (BV 5). The schedule-state, occupancy-state, manual-override and emergency-override multistate inputs (MV 1, 4, 5, 6) clash with network outputs in the guide and are not listed.
integration.heartbeat: Each shared network input has a fail-detect enable and delay (0-3600 s), for example occupancy BV 159 / AV 263, outdoor temperature BV 163 / AV 271, space temperature BV 168 / AV 282. When a bound input stops updating it falls back after the delay.
integration.remote_sensors: Network inputs: ni_SpaceTemp AV 104, ni_SpaceRH AV 80, ni_SpaceCO2 AV 81, ni_OutdoorTemp AV 89, ni_OutdoorHum AV 194, outdoor and return enthalpy/dew point AV 339-342. Sylk sensor values can be overridden through AV 238-251.
setup: BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP over Wi-Fi, not both; switching between them restarts the thermostat.
MS/TP: Device ID is set on the thermostat; auto MAC addressing is on by default. The baud rate is auto-detected in the first 4 minutes, otherwise 76,800.
ni_DeviceLock (AV 195) can lock changes to the GUI or to the network.
gotchas: Several objects share a type and instance in the guide (see notes); check on the device before mapping them.
ni_ApplicationMode is not kept after a power cycle; rewrite it after a restart.
